ENTERPRISE DATA PROTECTION AND REGULATORY COMPLIANCE POLICY (GDPR & SOC 2)

Version: 3.4
Effective Date: March 1, 2024
Organization: DataCore Global Infrastructure Ltd.

1. Scope and Objective:
This Data Protection Policy establishes the technical and organizational security controls implemented by DataCore Global Infrastructure Ltd. to ensure compliance with the General Data Protection Regulation (Regulation (EU) 2016/679 - GDPR) and SOC 2 Type II trust principles.

2. Technical Security and Encryption Controls:
All personal data processed by the platform shall be encrypted in transit using Transport Layer Security (TLS 1.3) with forward secrecy, and encrypted at rest using Advanced Encryption Standard (AES-256) cipher keys. Multi-factor authentication (MFA) and role-based access control (RBAC) are strictly enforced across all production environments.

3. Security Incident and Breach Notification:
In the event of a confirmed or suspected personal data breach, the Data Protection Officer shall notify the competent supervisory authority without undue delay and, where feasible, not later than 72 hours after having become aware of it, in full compliance with Article 33 of the GDPR. Affected data subjects shall be notified immediately if the breach represents a high risk to their fundamental rights.

4. Data Subject Rights & Right to Erasure:
Data subjects possess the fundamental right to access, rectify, restrict, and permanently erase their personal data (the "right to be forgotten"). DataCore commits to fulfilling verified erasure requests within thirty (30) calendar days without charge.

5. Data Retention & Secure Disposal:
Customer telemetry and personal identification records shall be retained solely for the active duration of the customer service contract plus ninety (90) days. Upon retention expiration, all cryptographic keys and data storage sectors shall undergo certified NIST SP 800-88 cryptographic erasure.

6. Audit Verification & Monitoring:
DataCore shall undergo an independent, third-party SOC 2 Type II audit on an annual basis. Customers are entitled to inspect executive summaries of external audit reports and penetration tests upon written request.

Data Protection Officer: dpo@datacore-global.org
London, United Kingdom
